verse: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
notes: Faith believes before seeing. Trust God's promises even when you can't see the outcome.
Keep a prayerful attitude all day. Prayer isn’t limited to a specific time.

verse: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
notes: Christ is your source of strength for every challenge and victory.

verse: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
notes: God cares for you like a shepherd—providing, protecting, and guiding.

verse: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles...
notes: Waiting on God brings renewal and spiritual power. Don't rush—trust His timing.

verse: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
notes: Memorizing Scripture is a powerful defense against sin and temptation.

verse: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son...
notes: God’s love is sacrificial and universal. This is the heart of the gospel.

verse: Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed...
notes: God commands courage because He is with you—always and everywhere.

verse: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
notes: God’s wisdom surpasses yours. Full trust brings peace and direction.

verse: In everything give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
notes: Gratitude is God’s will. Find reasons to thank Him even in difficulty.
